forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. The Knesset dissolved July 17 at its natural mandatory term end — the first full-term Knesset completion since 1988. The coalition held 61/120 seats throughout and no roll-call vote confirmed a drop below 61. Netanyahu made no early-dissolution announcement moving the election before Oct 27; the Oct 27 election date is the statutory mandatory date. Neither resolution prong was met. Path to YES was operationally closed July 17.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Pezeshkian (SCO, Sep 1) stated 'if the US returns to its commitments in the Islamabad MoU, Iran will immediately reciprocate.' Araghchi made parallel conditional statements. The ambiguity_rule is unambiguous: conditional or preconditioned offers without US acceptance of the condition = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. The US made no public acceptance before EOD Sep 6. Active bilateral kinetic exchange (CENTCOM strikes, IRGC ballistic missiles at US warships) ran through the horizon window. No named official issued an unconditional public commitment to enter mediated negotiations.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: SEVERE UPDATE (p 0.22→0.08). Sep 5–8: CENTCOM destroyed 8 Iranian tankers across two separate retaliatory operations after successive IRGC ballistic-missile attacks on US warships, including an attack targeting a carrier on Sep 16. Hormuz daily transits: 7 (Sep 9), 4 (Sep 15), 12 (Sep 16). 7-day rolling average approximately 6–9 vessels, 5–7% of pre-war normal. Araghchi (Sep 13, Muscat) confirmed the Iran-Oman corridor plan 'does not mean the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz' and requires US Islamabad MoU compliance. Parliament speaker Ghalibaf: 'the era of proportionate responses has ended.' No insurer has reinstated P&I war-risk cover. Reaching 30-vessel 7-day average within 15 days requires a political settlement with no current pathway. UNGA window (Sep 18–28) and pre-negotiated Iran-Oman corridor plan preserve a small tail, preventing collapse to floor.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03. 7-day rolling window must close by EOD Oct 3.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS. 7-day rolling window must close by EOD Oct 3; partial windows do not resolve YES.

forecasts.question: Will Likud win the most Knesset seats (seat plurality) in the October 27, 2026 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (p 0.42→0.33). Sep 17 polling consolidation: four of five polls show Yashar at 22 seats ahead of Likud at 18 as the modal result; only i24NEWS shows Likud at 27 vs Yashar 22. Channel 13 projects Netanyahu bloc 54 vs Eisenkot bloc 52, but individual party race favors Yashar in modal polling. The 'PARTIAL' indicator on Likud >=23 seats no longer holds on the polling balance of evidence. 39 days remain; Israeli wartime polling carries historical uncertainty; the i24NEWS outlier and bloc arithmetic prevent a sharper downward move. Likud at 18 in the modal result vs Yashar at 22 is a 4-seat gap across the currently dominant polling frame.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Knesset election results published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee show Likud winning more seats than any other single party in the October 27, 2026 election.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official results, carried by Times of Israel/Haaretz/Reuters/AP.

forecasts.question: Will a named US official and a named Iranian official publicly confirm a direct communication or in-person contact during UNGA high-level week before EOD 2026-09-21?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 72h forecast. Trump Sep 16 claimed Iran contacted the US 'directly'; US granted visas to Pezeshkian and Araghchi on Sep 17 for UNGA. Both delegations arrive in New York Sep 18, removing the logistical barrier to contact. UNGA margins historically function as ad-hoc contact venues during adversarial periods. Active kinetic exchange and domestic political constraints on both sides cap probability; public confirmation requires both parties to acknowledge a politically sensitive event. P=0.28 reflects the logistical opportunity against the political-cost barrier.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-21, a named US official (Secretary of State, NSC Director, or Special Envoy) AND a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi or President Pezeshkian) each publicly confirm — or if two independent TIER1 sources simultaneously report — that a direct communication or in-person meeting between US and Iranian representatives occurred during UNGA high-level week. A public denial by either party = NO.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 sources (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/NYT/BBC), OR one TIER1 + one official statement (US State Dept, Iranian MFA, or IRNA/Tasnim quoting a named official).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump's unilateral claim without Iranian confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (consistent with F3 precedent). A mediator-only readout without US or Iranian named-official confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Protocol encounters in shared UN sessions without a deliberate bilateral exchange do not count.

forecasts.question: Will Pezeshkian deliver an explicit, named ceasefire proposal — referencing the Islamabad MoU or new specific terms — in his UNGA General Debate speech before EOD 2026-09-25?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 7-day forecast. Iran's consistent posture since Sep 1 SCO: conditional return to Islamabad MoU 'if US does.' UNGA is the highest-visibility multilateral venue available to Iran and Pezeshkian's first address to the full UN membership since the war began. Iranian state media has treated the Islamabad MoU as a binding agreement; Pezeshkian's speech is a predictable platform for making this conditional offer formally before the General Assembly. P=0.44 reflects that a conditional MoU restoration offer likely meets the resolution threshold, tempered by the possibility of a more combative tone given the Sep 5–16 escalation cycle.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Pezeshkian's UNGA General Debate speech, delivered before EOD 2026-09-25, contains an explicit named ceasefire proposal — either referencing Islamabad MoU restoration, or stating new specific terms (named conditions, timeline, or mediator) — and the speech text is carried by IRNA/Tasnim as an official statement. A general call for 'peace' without named conditions or MoU reference = NO.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Full speech text carried by IRNA/Tasnim OR United Nations verbatim records (un.org), corroborated by one TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A speech referencing the MoU but framed purely as US accusation without any forward-looking offer = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. If Pezeshkian is interrupted or the speech is not officially transmitted: AMBIGUOUS pending UN official transcript. A speech that mentions 'peace' only in general terms without naming the MoU or specific terms = NO.

forecasts.question: Will the Iran-Oman joint Hormuz maritime corridor plan be officially published (maps and joint statement released publicly) before EOD 2026-10-02?

forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-10-02, the official text of an Iran-Oman joint statement on Hormuz maritime corridor arrangements, including or accompanied by referenced maps, is published by IRNA, Oman News Agency, or a named Omani/Iranian ministerial statement.

A unilateral Iranian statement without Omani co-signature = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
